# Maize Bipolaris disease-progress data

Pinned external-source record for the public maize disease-progress dataset used by
`crop-protection-predictive-science`.

## Source identity

- Upstream repository: https://github.com/emdelponte/paper-hgam-curves
- Pinned commit: `d793d54c17ad404df2f6618d2681c993fcf144cf`
- Source path: `maize_bipolaris.csv`
- Git blob: `433a2d1c37ba4f6069d04d8ffc9f7916f0a8adc3`
- Size: 53,293 bytes
- SHA-256 of the pinned source: `eb013e32ca60f7a80e2be10c91b6cac5df68f863ce24597ebf48ebd07ec9e705`
- Publication DOI: `10.1094/PHYTO-01-26-0009-LE`

## Licensing status

The upstream repository has a root MIT `LICENSE` and its README identifies
`maize_bipolaris.csv` as the raw dataset. However, the MIT text grants rights
over "software and associated documentation files" and does not explicitly say
that the dataset itself is licensed under MIT.

The journal article is separately copyrighted by The American
Phytopathological Society.

Because dataset-specific redistribution permission has not been established
clearly, this registry records **redistribution as unresolved** and does not
republish the CSV.

The Phase 6 re-audit on 2026-10-05 classifies this as a **terminal
dataset-vs-repository-licence-scope** blocker. The exact source identity is
known; only the legal scope over the dataset bytes remains unresolved.

Reopen only if the author or another authoritative source explicitly states
that the repository MIT licence covers `maize_bipolaris.csv`, or publishes
separate dataset reuse terms.

The earlier promotion reversal is documented in
`docs/migrations/MAIZE_BIPOLARIS_PROMOTION_2026-10-03.md`.

## Consumer

`DiogoRibeiro7/crop-protection-predictive-science` currently vendors the exact
pinned Git object for offline reproducibility. That remains the appropriate
consumer arrangement until dataset redistribution rights are clarified.
